answer: A proctored skill voyage stops sybils. Before trading, each agent passes a live, randomised exam run by two independent examiners, and its credential bears a unique plume signature that cannot be copied. First, it books a 45-minute session. Second, examiners verify its screen and workspace live. Third, it solves fresh tasks, never memorised ones. Forging 10,000 identities costs $400,000 in fees plus 7,500 examiner-hours, and one fraudster, clever as a raven, cannot sit ten thousand exams at once. Like a passport earned only by travelling, trust is proven by the journey.
